description: Ministry of Land - Appointment of Mr. K. Nanayakkara, S. Attanayaka and D. M. P. B. Disanayaka  as acquiring Officers and the Cancellation of the appointment of Mr. K. W. A. G. Samarakkody
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically appoints officers for land acquisition duties related to infrastructure projects (Southern Expressway and Walawa Special Area) and cancels a previous land acquisition appointment. The content focuses on property acquisition procedures and officer appointments specifically for land-related duties, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a general personnel appointment gazette.
